prompt: Extract the action items from these meeting notes as a table. [followed by all 10 notes; full prompt in artifact/prompts/step1.txt]
output_summary: Tab-separated table (#, Meeting, Action, Owner, Deadline) plus a closing paragraph. 36/36 items found, 36/36 fully correct (owner and deadline right). 1 extra row.
problem_seen: Extra row: listed Meher's optional sitar idea ('only if there is time') as a task. Closing paragraph has a factual error (says 6 items have no owner and counts the lyrics task, which is owned by Meher; real count is 5). 'No deadline' written 3 different ways (Not set / Date not fixed / Date to be decided).
change_next: Add one rule: only include tasks someone has firmly agreed to do; exclude decisions, info updates, cancelled tasks, tasks already done and optional ideas.
why: The prompt never defines what an action item is, so the model included a tentative 'might do' idea as a task.

prompt: Step 1 + 'Only include tasks that someone has firmly agreed to do. Do not include decisions, information updates, cancelled tasks, tasks that are already done, or optional ideas (for example "might" or "only if there is time").' [full prompt in artifact/prompts/step2.txt]
output_summary: Tab-separated table plus a 'Left out' list. 30/36 items found, 30/36 fully correct, 0 extra rows. Sitar idea correctly excluded.
problem_seen: The rule backfired: 'firmly agreed' made the model drop all 5 tasks with no owner yet (drone operator, AC repair, insurance, piano, dinner) and Anaya's 'I can get the costume photos to Zoya by Saturday' (treated as an offer). Recall fell from 36 to 30. Still 2 spellings for no deadline and 7 lines of text outside the table.
change_next: Reword the scope rule: a task counts if someone said they will do it (including 'I can...') or the meeting said it needs doing even with no owner yet; for those write Owner = Unassigned. Keep the exclusions.
why: The word 'firmly agreed' was too strict. The model needs to know that unowned tasks still belong in the list, marked Unassigned.

prompt: Step 2 with the scope rule reworded: 'Include a task if someone said they will do it (including offers like "I can..."), or if the meeting said it needs to be done even though nobody owns it yet; for those, write the owner as Unassigned.' Exclusions kept. [full prompt in artifact/prompts/step3.txt]
output_summary: Tab-separated table plus a one-line 'Left out' note. 36/36 items found, 36/36 fully correct, 0 extra rows. All 5 unowned tasks back as Unassigned; Anaya's costume-photo offer back; sitar still excluded.
problem_seen: Content is now perfect, but the Deadline column is inconsistent: 'no deadline' written 3 ways (Not set / Not set (date not fixed) / Date to be decided), and the model adds comments in cells ('Thursday (for telling Rohan)'). It also added a detail not in the notes: 'Send premiere guest list to Tara' (Note 10 never says who receives it). 1 line of text outside the table.
change_next: Add one rule: write each deadline exactly as stated in the notes, and if there is no deadline write exactly None, with no extra words or brackets.
why: A fixed value for missing deadlines makes the table machine-readable (a script or spreadsheet filter can rely on 'None'), and banning bracket comments stops the model adding its own notes.

prompt: Step 3 + 'Write each deadline exactly as stated in the notes. If there is no deadline, write exactly None, with no extra words or brackets.' [full prompt in artifact/prompts/step4.txt]
output_summary: Tab-separated table plus 1 closing line. 36/36 items found, 35/36 fully correct, 0 extra rows. 'No deadline' now written one way only (None). Invented recipient ('to Tara') gone. Model split Note 9 into 2 rows (cut shoots / tell Rohan by Thurs), which is a valid reading.
problem_seen: Two side effects of 'exactly as stated': (1) Hindi deadlines copied untranslated: 'Friday tak', 'kal tak', 'Monday tak' (3 rows); (2) conditional deadlines ('after the score is done', 'once the shortlist comes') moved into the task text and deadline set to None, so 5.2 is now wrong. Still 1 line of text outside the table. Note: while reviewing I found my answer key was inconsistent (Note 2's two-task sentence was split but Note 9's was not), so the key now accepts Note 9 as one row or two; steps 1-3 scores are unchanged by this.
change_next: Rewrite the deadline sentence: write each deadline in English (translate Hindi, e.g. kal = tomorrow, tak = by); if the timing is a condition like 'after X' or 'once X', put that condition in the Deadline column; only if there is no timing at all, write exactly None.
why: The model followed 'exactly as stated' too literally. It needs to know the reader wants English, and that a condition is still a deadline.

prompt: Step 4 with the deadline sentence rewritten: 'Write each deadline in English (translate Hindi words, for example kal = tomorrow, tak = by). If the timing is a condition such as "after X" or "once X", put that condition in the Deadline column. Only if there is no timing at all, write exactly None, with no extra words or brackets.' [full prompt in artifact/prompts/step5.txt]
output_summary: Single tab-separated table, no other text. 36/36 items found, 36/36 fully correct, 0 extra rows, 0 text lines outside the table, 1 spelling for no deadline (None), 0 untranslated Hindi ('kal tak' -> Tomorrow). Conditions kept ('After the background score is done', 'Once the shortlist comes').
problem_seen: Content is fully correct, but the table no longer says which note each task came from (no Note/Meeting column). The prompt never fixed the columns, so the layout changed every run (step 1: #/Meeting/Action/Owner/Deadline; step 4: #/Owner/Task/Deadline/Meeting; step 5: #/Task/Owner/Deadline). The challenge asks for tables per meeting.
change_next: Specify the exact output format: one separate table per note, headed 'NOTE n', with exactly the columns Task | Owner | Deadline, and no other text.
why: A fixed format makes every run look the same and keeps each task linked to its meeting, so the output can be used directly and checked by script.

prompt: Step 5 + output format line: 'Output format: for each note, write a heading NOTE n followed by a separate markdown table with exactly these three columns in this order: Task | Owner | Deadline. Reply with only these 10 headings and tables, and no other text.' (first line shortened to 'Extract the action items from these meeting notes.' so it does not clash) [full prompt in artifact/prompts/step6.txt = artifact/final_prompt.txt]
output_summary: 10 headed tables (NOTE 1 to NOTE 10), each with exactly Task | Owner | Deadline, no other text. 36/36 items found, 36/36 fully correct, 0 extra rows, 0 tasks under the wrong note, 0 text outside tables, None/Unassigned used consistently, 0 untranslated Hindi.
problem_seen: No content errors left. Only a cosmetic inconsistency: some deadlines start with 'By' (By Friday, By 8 Dec) and some do not (Monday, Wednesday). Meaning is unaffected.
change_next: Stop changing the prompt. Freeze step 6 as final_prompt.txt and test it once on 3 new, unseen meeting notes.
why: All measured problems are fixed. A test on unseen notes shows whether the prompt generalises or is just tuned to these 10 notes.
